text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is just about to
start.
Мэдзиро МакКуин calmly reflects on
everything
that's led up to this day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She thinks back on the effort both she
and I have
put forth and on her many
experiences competing
with her rivals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She also recalls her race against Mejiro
Ryan, who
showed a sense of resolve
stronger than ever
before in the
Takarazuka Kinen
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Filled with determination, Mejiro
McQueen vows
to expend all her power
to win today's autumn
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
